narrative.details: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, adventurer. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
narrative.offerRewardText: Tsunaman sent you? Excellent. Then we have matters to discuss.
